entries.title: Psalms 86:1
segments:
PSALM LXXXVI. 
 
  David prays for the favour and blessing of God, ver. 1-6.   Expresses confidence in him, by praise mingled with prayer,   ver. 7-17.   A prayer of David.

entries.title: Psalms 86:2
segments: V. 2. Holy-Sincerely devoted to thy service.

entries.title: Psalms 86:11
segments: V. 11. Truth-In the way of thy precepts, which are true and right in all things.  My heart-Knit my whole heart to thyself.

entries.title: Psalms 86:13
segments: V. 13. Hell-From extreme dangers and miseries.
